name: dpx
description: Cross-border stablecoin settlement for AI agents — compliance-gated (AML/sanctions/PEP/UBO), ESG-scored, and non-custodial, on Base mainnet.

dpx_api_key.title: DPX API key (optional)
dpx_api_key.description: Subscription key for paid DPX tools. All settlement/compliance/FX-routing tools in this plugin work without one — only needed if you also install dpx-intelligence and want subscription-based access instead of per-call x402 payment. Get a free key at https://intelligence.untitledfinancial.com/v1/keys/create.
